summary: Oral sale agreement dispute over property where respondent executed sale deed using copy of power of attorney after alleged cancellation; Trial Court found sale valid under Registration Act provisions (Sections 18A, 33, 34) with certified copy sufficient, power of attorney subsisting as cancellation required registration, granted account rendition but denied injunction; High Court reversed concurrent findings in second appeal; Supreme Court examines validity of sale deed executed via certified power of attorney copy, mandatory compliance with Registration Act, and binding effect of principal-agent agreement.
final_judgment: The specific final judgment disposition is not explicitly stated in the provided text excerpt, though the case involves appeal against High Court's reversal of concurrent trial findings regarding property sale validity and account rendition.
